mechanism: Hydrocortisone may reduce the antihypertensive efficacy of sacubitril through sodium and fluid retention, while sacubitril's neprilysin inhibition may affect steroid metabolism and increase hyperglycemic effects of glucocorticoids.
action: Monitor blood pressure closely and adjust sacubitril dosing if needed; counsel on sodium restriction; assess for fluid retention and hyperglycemia; consider alternative corticosteroid if long-term therapy required.
